description: Create a person custom field. field_name and field_type are required. For enum/set types, options is required. The response data.field_code is the 40-char hash to keep for later updates.

field_type.description: Field type. Use 'enum' (single choice) or 'set' (multiple choice) for option fields.

important_fields.description: Important-field highlighting: enabled, stage_ids (always references DEAL stages, even on person/org fields).

options.description: Field options (required for enum and set field types)

required_fields.description: Required-field config: enabled (person/org fields support only this flag).

ui_visibility.description: UI visibility: add_visible_flag, details_visible_flag, show_in_add_deal_dialog{show, order}.

name: pipedrive_create_person_field
